requires: Permission com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND declared and granted
allow-external-apps=true in ~/.termux/termux.properties
Android 12+ (API 31+): Background start restrictions require explicit ComponentName and compliance with ForegroundService rules
ensures: Executes command within Termux environment and optionally returns stdout/stderr/exitCode

invariants: Value is 'com.termux.RUN_COMMAND'
Value is 'com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND'
Value is 'com.termux.RUN_COMMAND_PATH'
Must be an absolute path inside Termux prefix (e.g. /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash)
Value is 'com.termux.RUN_COMMAND_ARGUMENTS'
Value passed in intent must be String[] (String array)
Value is 'com.termux.RUN_COMMAND_WORKDIR'
Defaults to Termux HOME directory if not specified
Value is 'com.termux.RUN_COMMAND_BACKGROUND'
Boolean extra: true executes without opening a terminal window
Value is 'com.termux.RUN_COMMAND_SESSION_ACTION'
Values: '0'=new session, '1'=keep current, '2'=switch existing/create, '3'=fail if exists

requires: On Android 12+ (API 31+), must be created with PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE so Termux can attach result extras
ensures: Receives result extras: stdout, stderr, exitCode, errCode (truncated to 100KB to prevent TransactionTooLargeException)
invariants: Value is 'com.termux.RUN_COMMAND_PENDING_INTENT'
Value is 'com.termux.RUN_COMMAND_RESULT_DIRECTORY'
Directory where Termux will write output files for large payloads

POSIX/Linux OS with pseudo-terminal multiplexer support (/dev/ptmx)
ensures: Allocates a new pseudo-terminal pair returning (master_fd, slave_fd)
invariants: Parent must close slave_fd immediately after child spawn to ensure EOF propagation on child exit; master_fd must be closed when session finishes

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: Slave pseudo-terminal file descriptor to prepare for login session

requires: fd must be an open file descriptor referring to a terminal slave
Must be executed inside child process before exec (e.g. inside subprocess.Popen preexec_fn)
ensures: Makes caller a session leader via setsid(), sets fd as controlling terminal via TIOCSCTTY ioctl, duplicates fd to stdin (0), stdout (1), stderr (2), and closes fd if > 2
invariants: Child process is guaranteed to have isatty(0)==True, enabling interactive prompts, ANSI color, line buffering, and signal generation

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor to modify

parameters.name: blocking
parameters.description: False to enable O_NONBLOCK, True to disable

requires: Valid open file descriptor
Python 3.5+
ensures: Sets O_NONBLOCK flag atomically without overwriting other file status flags
invariants: When blocking=False, read operations never block execution and raise BlockingIOError if no bytes are available

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor to read from (PTY master_fd)

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Maximum number of bytes to read

requires: fd is an open readable descriptor
ensures: Returns raw byte buffer of available output from child process
invariants: CRITICAL POSIX PTY INVARIANT: When child exits or closes slave, reading from master_fd raises OSError with errno.EIO (Errno 5); this must be caught as normal EOF. In non-blocking mode, raises BlockingIOError if no data is pending.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor to write to (PTY master_fd)

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Raw bytes payload to deliver to child stdin

requires: fd is open and writable
data is a bytes-like object
ensures: Injects bytes into child terminal input buffer; returns number of bytes written
invariants: Terminal slave echoes back written characters unless ECHO is suppressed; line endings should end with newline
